plugins.name: explaining
plugins.description: The "Todd way" output style — explanatory-prose rules proven in an isolated A/B eval (term discipline, grounding, drawn flows, blind-reader review) folded together with the built-in Concise rules into one always-on style, plus the tools/ scripts it invokes. Replaces the skill of the same name, now archived.

plugins.name: epic-loop
plugins.description: Plan and run work bigger than one PR as a GitHub epic of linked issues (sub-issues, "blocked by", loop labels), so a loop of fresh agent sessions does it one task per run: plan the epic, run one tick, or drive it with subagents. The owner ratifies the goal once; after that the loop verifies itself and files findings as blocking issues instead of asking. Ships epic.mjs, which reads and writes the issue graph.
